title: potentilla cinerea var. arenaria
intro: Potentilla cinerea var. arenaria, commonly known as Silver Buffaloberry or Gray Buffaloberry, is a perennial shrub in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, as well as its role in supporting the immune system and reducing stress. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla cinerea var. arenaria include its ability to act as an antiviral and antibacterial agent, and to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
